import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
i=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
# demo1: bbox grows +1 on each side; inside grown area that was zero gets fill = least common nonzero color (5). Frame color stays.
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=0)
    ic=cnt.most_common()[-1][0]  # least common nonzero = hole color
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=0]
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==0 and any(abs(rr-r)<=1 and abs(cc-c)<=1 for rr,cc in cells):
                out[r][c]=ic
    return out

print('pair1 ok', f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# determine ic (fill) and fc (frame) per pair, then characterize fill cells vs frame cells
for p in (1,2,3):
    i=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    cnt=Counter(v for row in i for v in row if v!=0)
    ic,cnt=cnt.most_common()[-1][0],cnt.most_common(-1)[0][0] if len(cnt)>1 else None
    print(p,'colors:',dict(cnt),'assume frame=',max(c for c,n in cnt if n>len(set(c for v in cnt if True))) if False else sorted(cnt))
    ff={(r,c) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if i[r][c]==cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]}
    fill=[(r,c,i[r][c],o[r][c],max(abs(r-rf)-abs(c-cf)) for rf,cf in ff if False)]
    # Chebyshev distances from nearest frame cell
    def dist(r,c):
        best=min(abs(r-rf)+abs(c-cf) for rf,cf in ff)
        return best
    ds=[dist(r,c) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if i[r][c]==0 and o[r][c]==cnt.most_common()[-1][0]]
    print(' fill Chebyshev distances:', sorted(set(ds)))

def load():

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

import numpy as np, os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
